summary: Legitimacy vs paternity determination; maintenance petition revival under S.125 CrPC; Family Court jurisdiction vs Civil Courts; applicability of Evidence Act S.112 presumption; finality of prior judgments; civil suit for paternity declaration; DNA test admissibility standards; jurisdictional conflict between Family Courts Act, 1984 S.7(e)(f) and CrPC proceedings; maintenance entitlement dependent on paternity proof; binding effect of concluded litigation.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; Family Court's order reviving maintenance petition quashed; civil court's final determination on paternity binding; Respondent restricted from raising same paternity claim in subsequent proceedings.
